title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 11, section 5 (Management Unit 1-1)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 11 Prohibited Discharge Areas — Rifles (Section 10 (1) (c))
Management Unit 1-1
5 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within the boundaries of M.U. 1-1, excepting those portions of Valdes Island, Sidney Island or James Island located above the mean high water mark. [en. B.C. Reg. 318/98, App. 2, s. 4.]
